items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: I know my daddy did. He played in a brass band. Dad was put up by Joe Gabriel.

ctx.x: Did they play in a brass band up there? Or what did they play?
Yeah. Well I don't know too much about their life of playing in brass bands there. But I know my daddy did. He played in a brass band. Dad was put up by Joe Gabriel. Thibodeau.
Oh yes. Lewis James told us about that band. I guess you knew him up there too.

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: He played with Joe Gabriel after my daddy died.

ctx.x: He has fainting spells now, you know. And whenever you go to see him, he gets excited and faints. So I don't know whether we'll be able to do it or not. We ought to go try it anyway. Anyhow, what kind of brass band was that? Did it have a name or anything?
And he just used his own name for it. Do you know how big it was? Do you remember it at all?
